2.source: relic set 308 (生命的翁瓦克 / Sprightly Vonwacq), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by #1[i]%. When the wearer's SPD is equal to or higher than #2[i], immediately advances the wearer's action forward by #3[i]% when entering battle." param = [0.05, 120, 0.4]
2.note: Only the conditional sentence; "Energy Regeneration Rate +5%" is the effect's `properties` stat (SPRatioBase 0.05). ⚠ The event is BATTLE_START and not TURN_START on purpose: the text says "when entering battle", and this is the only rule where the wording and the once-at-battle-start timing agree exactly -- the other planar 2-pieces say "when the wearer's SPD is >= N" (continuous) and are approximated by the same event. ADVANCE defaults to the rule's owner, and the action bar already exists by the time BATTLE_START fires (the queue is built in Battle's constructor), so the pull is real rather than a no-op.
